flashcards.q: Fabric billing model and SKU range?
flashcards.a: SaaS capacity units shared across all workloads: F2..F2048 SKUs; usage smooths over ~minute windows, bursts briefly exceed baseline, sustained overage throttles interactive first then background jobs.
Shortcuts = virtual no-copy references to ADLS/S3/Databricks data; mirroring = continuous near-real-time replication of OLTP (Azure SQL/Cosmos) INTO OneLake Delta tables.

flashcards.q: Fabric Spark runtime facts and accelerations?
flashcards.a: RT 1.3 = Spark 3.5 GA, RT 2.0 = Spark 4.0 preview; Native Execution Engine (Velox/Gluten) up to ~4x TPC-DS-class gains; single-node minimum pools vs Synapse's 3-node minimum; V-order adds ~15-33% write overhead for read gains.
Hash (big fact tables on join keys), round-robin, REPLICATE (small dimensions cached per node eliminating shuffle - degrades once tables grow). Watch hash skew via space-usage views.

flashcards.q: Serverless SQL pool billing model and proper role?
flashcards.a: ~Per-TB scanned over lake files via OPENROWSET/T-SQL; exploration layer ONLY - careless queries scan terabytes invisibly; production serving belongs in provisioned engines.
Azure IR (managed cloud execution), Self-hosted IR (customer VM bridging on-prem/private networks - the ONLY path there; run 2+ nodes for HA), SSIS IR (lift-and-shift SSIS packages).

flashcards.q: Databricks cost model and governance layer?
flashcards.a: DBU markup atop VM spend in YOUR subscription; job clusters die with jobs, all-purpose bill idle time; Unity Catalog provides catalog.schema.table governance spanning workspaces.

flashcards.q: What does Delta ACID add over plain Parquet?
flashcards.a: Transactional reads/writes across files, MERGE/UPDATE/DELETE, time travel, schema enforcement+evolution; costs: transaction-log overhead, small-file compaction (OPTIMIZE), vacuum management.
1 TU ~= 1 MB/s OR 1000 events/s ingress, 2 MB/s OR 4096 events/s egress; up to 40 TUs/namespace; auto-inflate available; retention <=7 days standard.

flashcards.q: Premium processing units and partition flexibility?
flashcards.a: PU sizes 1,2,4..16 (~5-10 MB/s ingress each, CPU/memory isolated); partitions CAN increase post-creation unlike Standard where partition count is immutable.
Partitions = max parallel consumers per consumer group; excess instances idle by design; ordering guaranteed only WITHIN a partition - key messages by entity needing order.
Wire-protocol compatible: swap bootstrap servers + port 9093; ordering maps to partition semantics identically; Capture writes streams to Blob/Lake automatically (avro/json).
Monotone watermark + deliberate overlap window + idempotent downstream MERGE absorbs late arrivals; works identically whether target is Delta MERGE, CTAS-swap, or UPSERT.

flashcards.q: Greenfield pick among Fabric / Synapse / Databricks?
flashcards.a: Fabric for MS-aligned BI+lakehouse default; Databricks when ML lifecycle depth/Spark scale/multi-cloud matters; Synapse only for extending existing estates (dedicated pools deprecated-by-guidance).
